safety.label:
«requirement»
Safety
Crew safety is not Launch
Escape System only. The Range
Safety Officer sits outside
Mission Control.

land.label:
«requirement»
Land
Two crew land. The flown
landing program is P66.
Primary Guidance lands;
Abort Guidance does not.

talk.label:
«requirement»
Talk
Mission Control talks to the
stack on Unified S-Band.

abort.label:
«requirement»
Abort
Abort Guidance is not a landing
computer. Pad and Mode I sit
with the escape tower; later
modes do not.

air.label:
«requirement»
Air
Life support is oxygen, water,
and lithium hydroxide. Lunar
Module descent oxygen is a
teaching figure, not a
required pressure.

guide.label:
«requirement»
Guide
Two Block II guidance computers.
Primary Guidance, Navigation,
and Control is not Abort
Guidance. Landing radar is on
descent; rendezvous radar is
on ascent.
